description: Narrative slots — charts are filled deterministically in charts.py

questions.question: Short page title (max 80 characters) for the HTML report. Title text only.
Short cover eyebrow line (e.g. Pilot — Message analysis). Text only.
Main headline: how were the messages received? Max 120 characters. Headline only.
Subtitle of 2–3 sentences: what was tested and how many runs. Plain text. Use only topics/tones from describe_runs — do not invent Elder care/Traffic.
Short label max 6 words (e.g. Key insight). Never a full sentence.
1–2 sentences for the first cover box. Optional <strong>. No outer wrapper.
Short label max 6 words (e.g. What worked). Never a full sentence.
1–2 sentences: what gained traction. Optional <strong>.
Short label max 6 words (e.g. What we tested). Never a full sentence.
One sentence with run/agent counts from the facts. Optional <strong>.
Short scenario label based on the injected messages. Text only.
Short topic list from topic_shares in describe_runs. One line, semicolon-separated. No invented topics.
Overline for the infographic (e.g. SUMMARY). Max 8 words.
Headline: What did the tests show? or equivalent. Headline only.
One lead sentence under the infographic headline. Plain text, no markdown.
Headline + 1 sentence main insight. Inner HTML only — never markdown **.
Headline + what did not work. Inner HTML — never markdown **.
Headline + warning/limitation. Inner HTML — never markdown **.
Method intro of 2–3 sentences about the simulation. Plain text.

Five steps. Each step EXACTLY:
N

…

…

. Only the five divs. Never the attribute mstep-num.
Why simulate? + 2 sentences. Inner HTML — never markdown **.
Reception intro of 2–3 sentences. Text. Use topic_shares/tone_shares from the tools.
Two finding cards: <div class="fc neu|pos|neg|cau"> with badge, h3, p. Space between fc and modifier (not fc-neu).
Message-style intro of 1–2 sentences. Text. Unclassified means no style match.
Two <div class="fc pos|neu"> with style analysis. Space in class.
Short headline for topic drift (max ~80 characters). Headline only — no markdown, no analysis.
Topic-drift intro of 2–3 sentences from topic_shares. Plain text without markdown.
Strategic takeaway: start with What does this mean? + 2–3 sentences. Use , never **. Inner HTML.
Opinion-leader intro of 2 sentences. Text. Quotes may be weather jokes — do not claim everything is message impact.
Comparison intro of 2 sentences. For A/B (Version A vs B): say explicitly it is A/B and what differs. Otherwise audience segments/multiple runs.
Two cards: <div class="fc neu"> and <div class="fc cau"> (space). For A/B: one card on A vs B difference, one on uncertainty. Only the two divs.
